notes.title: Update 10.04.19
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34741690/bebaa27cde11b531928dd0698eaf1afcc9a88d8e.png[/img]

Good morning, soldiers!

Thanks for your feedback! In this update, we have tried to correct some shortcomings that are acutely affecting the gameplay:

[list]
[*] In the first mission, the fog was a little moved. Now to distinguish the enemy in the distance should become easier.
[*] In the first mission, the AI ​​of the tanks was corrected and their slaughter was reduced.
[*] At the beginning of the third mission, the AI ​​of tanks was corrected and their slaughter was reduced.
[*] Several minor bug fixes.
[/list]

We are closely watching all comments and suggestions, and as necessary will support the game and correct the errors found.

Thank you all for your attention!
